description: This file defines a class `FormatWithBase64Encode` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. The class provides a method to encode a given value into Base64 format.

classes.name: FormatWithBase64Encode
classes.description: A class that implements value formatting by Base64 encoding the input value.

methods.description: Returns the Base64-encoded version of the input value.
